title: Tech Note: PostImage
author: Chiheb Nasr
featured_technology: Picture field storage from uploaded BLOB

historical_commentary.text: Chiheb Nasr (4D S.A. Technical Support Engineer) shows how to accept a picture uploaded from an HTML `<INPUT type=file>` form via `multipart/form-data` POST, receive it into a BLOB variable declared in the `Compiler_Web` method, parse the CR+LF+CR+LF-delimited BLOB header to extract the picture's name and type, and store the result in a 4D Picture field, explicitly pitched as approachable for beginners. Accepting image uploads from a web client into 4D is still a common requirement, but this exact 2001-era mechanism — hand-parsing a raw multipart BLOB header via a 4DACTION and the built-in Web Server — has been superseded by 4D's modern REST/ORDA APIs and richer native multipart/file-upload handling, making the specific implementation obsolete even though the underlying goal persists.
related_updates: 4D's REST/ORDA APIs now provide more modern mechanisms for handling file/image uploads from web and mobile clients
4D's built-in Web Server has gained more native multipart/form-upload handling since 2001, reducing the need for manual BLOB header parsing
